usedFor: Each “New Quote” in AutoQuote3D opens a deal in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Quote” in AutoQuote3D, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A quote is an open opportunity, so a deal lets you follow up before it cools.

watchOut: “New Quote” polls, so HubSpot updates only after the next check.
